LanguageData.BOR_Adreamoline.label: adreamoline
LanguageData.BOR_Adreamoline.description: An advanced chemical compound made from liquefied Sunsteel and specially prepared Tenebrite, adreamoline negates the user's need for rest, allowing them to function indefinitely without getting tired. Due to the glaring imperfections within Sunsteel, there is a small but non-negligible risk of addiction.
